thought.text: Perbedaan bukan di header — kemungkinan curl memakai proxy dari environment. Saya cek dan bandingkan langsung.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && env | grep -iE "proxy" | sed 's/=.*/=<set>/'; echo "=== curl no-proxy ==="; curl -s --noproxy '*' --max-time 25 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"claimToken":"x","recaptchaToken":"y","trigger":"auto"}' "https://dash.allmodels.io/api/free-credits/claim" -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n"; echo "=== python tanpa proxy ==="; python3 -c "
import json,urllib.request,urllib.error
op=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
req=urllib.request.Request('https://dash.allmodels.io/api/free-credits/claim',data=json.dumps({'claimToken':'x','recaptchaToken':'y','trigger':'auto'}).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/120'})
try:
    print(op.open(req,timeout=30).status)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print(e.code,e.read()[:200])
"
